rationale: Exact proposal, candidate, unchanged authored-v8 and both semantic-review bindings were independently verified; inherited factual verdicts and predecessor URL lists remain intact. All four prescribed derived/quick metadata pins match the current artifacts, and all 132 runtime hashes and nine source bindings match current files. Each addition preserves its archived fixture/runtime edge provenance, permitted orientation, non-distractor status and minimum strength of 0.7, without new seeds, targets or out-of-core results. All 27 core recipe maps, routes, categories, seeds, targets and par values match the archived candidate cores; an independent bounded breadth-first planner over merged recipes confirms the same minimum par within six actions for every board. The saved native audit accepts these structural projections, graph snapshots and finite-planner results. Its replay-labelled counts are not HTTP or game-session replay coverage.
